description: This file defines the ReturnAction class within the Opencart administrative localisation module. The class manages CRUD operations for return actions in the database, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return action records, along with handling associated descriptions and caching.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Model class for managing return actions, including CRUD operations, descriptions, and caching within the Opencart admin localisation module.

methods.name: addReturnAction
methods.description: Creates a new return action record in the database, inserting language-specific descriptions, and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: editReturnAction
methods.description: Edits an existing return action record by deleting the current one and adding new descriptions, then clearing the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnAction
methods.description: Deletes a return action record from the database and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnActionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return action records associated with a specific language ID, then clears the cache.

methods.name: getReturnAction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return action record by its ID, filtered for the current language.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Retrieves multiple return action records, with optional filtering, sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalReturnActions
methods.description: Returns the total count of return action records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description record for a return action in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific description for a return action in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return action ID across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
